comment: Reviewed exemptions for the contracts gate's bounded-wire-string sweep (G18). Every z.string() in the wire contract (packages/contracts/src, plus packages/schema/src) must carry a .max(N) so a client cannot send an arbitrarily large payload the server buffers and stores. A genuinely-unbounded string the contract accepts on purpose goes here as {"site": "packages/contracts/src/<file>.ts:<line>", "reason": "..."}. Write-guard-protected + gate-integrity-hashed: widening it is a reviewed human act.

allow.reason: Not unbounded: the site is `timestampText(z.string())`, and the timestampText helper (same file) applies `.regex(...).max(64)` to the schema it receives. The textual chain scan cannot see through the helper call; the bound is real and asserted by the contracts unit tests.
